title: When the Semester Sings
author: Jonah Okafor
blurb: Sebastian Nakamura, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
